generate_nschools_data: generate synthetic N schools dataset with configurable states, districts, and types for Bayesian modeling
evaluate_posterior_predictive_likelihood: evaluate the posterior predictive log-likelihood of test data against posterior samples from the N schools model
create_nschools_train_test_split: create balanced train and test xarray datasets for the N schools hierarchical model with equal school distribution
